  "root_cause": "VLAN 60's SVI on the router lacks an ip helper-address command, which prevents DHCP broadcast requests from clients on VLAN 60 from being forwarded to the centralized DHCP server on VLAN 10.",
  "confidence": 95,
  "evidence": "show running-config interface Vlan60 shows an IP address configured but no ip helper-address, whereas VLAN 10 correctly has 'ip helper-address 10.10.10.5' configured.",
  "next_command": "show running-config interface Vlan60",
  "fix_steps": [
    "Log into the core router/switch.",
    "Enter global configuration mode and navigate to interface Vlan60.",
    "Add the command 'ip helper-address 10.10.10.5' (using the IP address of the DHCP server).",
    "Verify by testing if a laptop on VLAN 60 successfully receives an IP address."
  ]
}
